column1: # /Graph Options Advanced — slice D Advanced (menu shell only).
# branches into Colors, Hatches, and Text. Each affects raster output
# only and needs data-model fields not present today; this slice wires
# the navigation shell so the menu tree is fully traversable. The
# leaves remain NotImplemented stubs until slice F.
# /GOA descends into Advanced and shows its three sub-leaves on line 2.
# Picking Colors stays in the menu and surfaces a NotImplemented tag
# Esc backs up one level — still inside /Graph (panel visible).
# /GOAQ pops out of Advanced back to /GO.
# Esc out of /GO, then again out of /G, lands in READY.
